name: Fear of Darkness
source:
The game follows a young detective pulled into her first murder case – one that quickly turns more personal than she could have anticipated. At the center is a girl connected to the victim, and a tangled web of unanswered questions.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250729050328/https://gasolineteapot.itch.io/fod]Itch.io[/url]] (archived page)
translation:
游戏讲述了一位年轻侦探卷入她的第一起谋杀案的故事，这起案件很快就变得比她预想的更加个人化。中心是一个与受害者有联系的女孩，以及一张由未解答的问题组成的错综复杂的网络。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250729050328/https://gasolineteapot.itch.io/fod]Itch.io[/url]]（存档页面）
